'''Premiere &ndash; Jabba's Palace''' (display name '''Premiere - Jabba's Palace'''; GEMP code <code>premiere_jp</code>) is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Jabba's Palace]].

Decipher Deck Designs from 1998 (April through October, after Jabba's Palace and before [[Special Edition]]) used this pool. On [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com]<ref name="play">[https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com], GEMP. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009095947/https://play.swccg.com/ Internet Archive].</ref> the same environment is <code>premiere_jp</code> (set ids 1&ndash;6 plus premium ids 101&ndash;107).

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
